<h1 class="unnumbered" id="algebraic-structures-lecture-notes">Algebraic
Structures – Lecture Notes</h1>
<p>These are long-form lecture notes written in LaTeX, similar in spirit
to a single long Markdown document.</p>
<p>You can write normal text in paragraphs. Math works with inline
notation like <span class="math inline">\(a \in \mathbb{Z}_n\)</span>
and display math:</p>
<p><span class="math display">\[a + b \equiv c \pmod{n}.\]</span></p>
<h2 class="unnumbered" id="example-homomorphism-phi-mathbbz-to-mathbbz_n">Example: Homomorphism
<span class="math inline">\(\phi : \mathbb{Z} \to
\mathbb{Z}_n\)</span></h2>
<p>Define <span class="math display">\[\phi(a) = a \bmod n.\]</span></p>
<p>Then <span class="math display">\[\phi(a+b) = \phi(a) +
\phi(b)\]</span> so <span class="math inline">\(\phi\)</span> is a group
homomorphism from <span class="math inline">\((\mathbb{Z},+)\)</span> to
<span class="math inline">\((\mathbb{Z}_n,+)\)</span>.</p>
<h2 class="unnumbered" id="including-an-image">Including an Image</h2>
<p>Here is an example of inserting an image (e.g., a diagram of <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{Z}_n\)</span>):</p>
<figure id="fig:mod-wheel" data-latex-placement="h">
<img role="img" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="width:50.0%" />
<figcaption>Modulo <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> wheel
illustrating the homomorphism <span class="math inline">\(a \mapsto a
\bmod n\)</span>.</figcaption>
</figure>
<p>Continue with more sections, examples, and problems as needed. You
can treat this as “one long page” of notes.</p>
<h2 class="unnumbered" id="practice-problems">Practice Problems</h2>
<ol>
<li><p>Show that <span class="math inline">\((\mathbb{Z}_6, +)\)</span>
is a cyclic group.</p></li>
<li><p>Find all generators of <span class="math inline">\((\mathbb{Z}_{10}, +)\)</span>.</p></li>
<li><p>Prove that <span class="math inline">\(\phi(a) = a \bmod
4\)</span> is a homomorphism <span class="math inline">\(\mathbb{Z} \to
\mathbb{Z}_4\)</span>.</p></li>
</ol>
</body>
